mode_evidence: The sequence he describes is perceptual in form: the crystal itself looks hazy, clouded, then 'exceeding bright', with pin points of light like stars, and then a blue ocean of space on which the vision appears. He also speaks of the 'interior vision, or eye of the soul' and says some pictures are mere visualisation, so the mode is not settled.
onset_evidence: For one who sees nothing: sit calmly with a steady gaze for ten minutes at the first sitting, fifteen at the second, same place, position and hour. Nothing is usually seen on the first occasion and possibly not for several sittings; perseverance, calm and patience are the 'royal road'. Time scales: ten to fifteen minutes per sitting, sometimes one or two hours before a result. Once haze and pin-points appear the instruction is to persevere with confidence.

conditions.gaze_or_eye_position: eyes fixed on the crystal with a steady calm gaze, not a fierce stare; look lengthwise through it for distant events
conditions.setting: a room not dark but shadowed, like a cloudy or wet day, about 60-65 F; crystal on a black velvet cushion, partly wrapped with black silk to cut reflections; no direct light on it
conditions.duration_and_schedule: 10 minutes first sitting, 15 the second, then longer; same place and time; best at sunrise, midday, sunset; not soon after a meal
conditions.prerequisites: calm, patience, light diet; fasting 24 hours is said to help; cleanliness
conditions.other: quiet company seated at a distance, low voices if questions are asked

stages.label: hazy or dull
stages.description: The crystal looks hazy or dull: a sign that you are likely to see.

stages.label: pin points
stages.description: Dull or cloudy with small pin points of light glittering like tiny stars; the crystal may alternately appear and disappear as in a mist.

stages.label: clouded or black
stages.description: Immediately before the apparition the crystal clouds or darkens ('black').

stages.label: bright
stages.description: It then becomes exceeding bright, as if lit by an effulgence from its interior.

stages.label: blue ocean of space
stages.description: Blindness to all else but a blue or bluish ocean of space, against which the vision is clearly apparent.

what_to_do_with_light: Keep gazing and persevere with confidence through the hazy and star-speckled stages; the vision appears against the blue.
obstacles_and_fixes: Nothing seen at first: repeat sittings with the same time and place; do not despair
Reflections: screen with black silk, keep light off the face of the crystal
Impatience, anxiety, ill-health and heavy diet hinder
cautions: Ceremonial evocation of spirits is dangerous and only for trained votaries
If the seer's purpose is evil it reacts upon him sooner or later
Direct sunlight is said to ruin the crystal's susceptibility
interpretation: Melville attributes the brightness to magnetism and iron in the crystal plus an efflux of magnetism from the gazer's eyes (citing Reichenbach), and he separates mere visualisation from true clairvoyant crystal vision.
practice_summary: Choose a shadowed, quiet room, not dark, comfortably warm. Set a crystal on a black velvet cushion, partly screened with black silk so that no light or reflection falls on it. Sit comfortably and gaze steadily, without a fierce stare, for ten minutes at the first sitting, fifteen at the second, at the same time and place. Expect nothing at first and possibly for several sittings. The signs of progress are haze or dullness in the crystal, pin points of light like tiny stars, a mist that comes and goes, a clouding or blackening, then a brightness as if lit from within, and finally a blue ocean of space on which the vision appears. Keep calm, eat lightly, avoid sittings after meals, and persevere.
